newsitem.title: USA: Gannett ups qtly div, okays stock split.
newsitem.headline: Gannett ups qtly div, okays stock split.

text.p: Gannet Co said Tuesday its board raised its quarterly dividend to $0.38 from $0.36 and approved a two-for-one split of the company's common stock.
The dividend is payable on the pre-split shares on October 1 to shareholders of record on September 12.
The stock split provides for a 100 percent stock distribution on October 6, with shareholders of record on September 12 receiving one additional share for each share held.
The dividend increase will raise the annual cash payment from $1.44 to $1.52 per share before distributiion of the two-for-one split and to $0.76 per share after distribution.
